snippet.title: Champions Tactics Reforged - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The grim arenas of Grimoria await.

In Champions Tactics: Reforged, assemble your team of unique champions and enter a world of dark strategy and tactical PvP warfare. Outsmart rivals in turn-based duels where every move counts.

The Reforging begins.

⚔️ Play for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3546740/Champions_Tactics_Reforged/
